context: Global-access expansion after v1.5 targeted coverage baseline and user request for maximum non-VPN/non-proxy reachability.
objective: Maximize safe direct Internet reachability without VPN/proxy/default-route tunneling by adding user-extensible host scope, selectable DPI strategy strength, optional all-sites scope, security-gated third-party evaluation, and stronger built-in coverage.

windows: Custom Sites editor with normalized domain/URL input, 256-entry cap, exact-host ^ support, protected runtime merge, symlink/reparse rejection.
Optional All Sites scope for unknown blocked domains; default remains Targeted to minimize compatibility/latency risk.
Built-in host coverage expanded with OpenAI/ChatGPT/GitHub support in addition to YouTube/Gemini/Adult-site targets.
Adult-site live check remains privacy-labeled 'Adult site', toggleable and default OFF.
linux: Custom Sites editor/persistence with normalized domain input and 256-entry cap.
Optional All Sites scope; default Targeted.
Protected helper validates user config, merges bounded host lists, records strategy/scope in runtime state, and dry-runs nfqws strategy arguments before launching.
security: Third-party suspicious component admission policy established.
Rejected hash registry + CI audit prevents quarantined/unapproved executable/archive hashes from becoming tracked product files.
zapret2 v1.0.5.2 official release digest verified, then Windows archive rejected after Microsoft Defender Severe/Concrete Trojan detection; no restore/exclusion.
Linux nfqws2 was version-queried only in isolated non-privileged PrivateNetwork systemd user sandbox; no privileged/networked packet execution.

evidenceFirstDecisions.claim: Do not ship zapret2 Windows binaries despite useful features.
evidenceFirstDecisions.rationale: Connectivity benefit does not justify overriding a failed severe malware gate; useful strategy concepts can be reused with already-accepted runtime.

evidenceFirstDecisions.claim: Do not enable global/all-sites DPI scope by default.
evidence: zapret official documentation recommends minimum traffic interception and documents hostlist scoping; broad manipulation can reduce compatibility/speed
evidenceFirstDecisions.rationale: Targeted is minimum-sufficient default; user can opt into All Sites when unknown blocked domains require it.

evidenceFirstDecisions.claim: Provide Custom Sites and multiple strategy profiles instead of requiring source edits or blind reruns.
evidence: current v1.4 live Windows check reached YouTube/OpenAI/GitHub but Adult/Reddit remained blocked; explicit static v1.5 target strategy alone did not prove universal coverage
evidenceFirstDecisions.rationale: User-extensible scope plus bounded strategy escalation converts future site failures into controllable product behavior.

v140LiveWindowsComparison.interpretation: v1.4 proves core direct engine but not universal access; server-side Gemini 403 is not removable by DPI bypass alone.

boundaries: No direct-only design can guarantee every remote site: remote server/account/region/age/product policy can still reject access.
Gemini HTTP 403 on the current egress is REACHABLE but not PASS; changing DPI/DNS does not change public egress IP.
All Sites scope is intentionally opt-in because global packet manipulation may hurt compatibility/performance.
Linux installed protected-backend live promotion still requires one local administrator authentication.
exactNextAction: Commit/push this expansion, pass protected CI, reproduce Linux artifact from a fresh remote checkout, then install exact candidate on Windows and Linux and close Start->live-sites->Stop->Recovery gates before publishing v1.5.0.
